chunks: A number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Ibrahim ibn Abd al-Rahman, from Ziyad, from Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him), who said:
The smoke of the pomegranate tree repels vermin.
ai.seo_question: What is the benefit of pomegranate tree smoke according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Recorded in al-Kafi by Shaykh al-Kulayni, this hadith from Imam al-Rida (peace be upon him) highlights the pomegranate tree's utility in repelling vermin, reflecting the Shia tradition of integrating natural remedies with spiritual wisdom. It underscores the holistic view of creation in Imami thought, where specific plants possess divinely ordained properties beneficial for daily life and health.

en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ibrahim Bin Abul Rahman, from Ziyad, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Smoke of the Pomegranate negates the vermin’.
en.sarwar: 18. A number of our people have narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad from Ibrahim ibn ‘Abd al-Rahman from Ziyad who has said the following: “Abu al-Hassan, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
Smoke from the tree of pomegranate dispels vermin?”
